lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਤੁਲੁ ਕਿਉ ਤੋਲੀਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਤੋਲੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: atul kiu toleeai vin tole paaiaa na jaai ||
lines.translation: How can the unweighable be weighed? Without weighing Him, He cannot be obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad veechaareeai gun mahi rahai samaai ||
lines.translation: Reflect on the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and immerse yourself in His Glorious Virtues.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਆਪਿ ਤੋਲਸੀ ਆਪੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: apanaa aap aap tolasee aape milai milaai ||
lines.translation: He Himself weighs Himself; He unites in Union with Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis kee keemat naa pavai kahanaa kichhoo na jaai ||
lines.translation: His value cannot be estimated; nothing can be said about this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚੀ ਬੂਝ ਦਿਤੀ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau balihaaree gur aapane jin sachee boojh ditee bujhaai ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to my Guru; He has made me realize this true realization.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਗਤੁ ਮੁਸੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਲੁਟੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jagat musai a(n)mrit luteeai manamukh boojh na paai ||
lines.translation: The world has been deceived, and the Ambrosial Nectar is being plundered. The self-willed manmukh does not realize this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲਸੀ ਜਾਸੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vin naavai naal na chalasee jaasee janam gavaai ||
lines.translation: Without the Name, nothing will go along with him; he wastes his life, and departs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਜਾਗੇ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਘਰੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਦੂਤਾ ਕਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਵਸਾਇ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: guramatee jaage tinhee ghar rakhiaa dootaa kaa kichh na vasaai ||8||
lines.translation: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings and remain awake and aware, preserve and protect the home of their heart; demons have no power against them. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਨਾ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ਨਾ ਤਰਸਾਇ ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: baabeehaa naa bilalaai naa tarasaai ehu man khasam kaa hukam ma(n)n ||
lines.translation: O rainbird, do not cry out. Do not let this mind of yours be so thirsty for a drop of water. Obey the Hukam, the Command of your Lord and Master,

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਤਿਖ ਉਤਰੈ ਚੜੈ ਚਵਗਲਿ ਵੰਨੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak hukam ma(n)niai tikh utarai chaRai chavagal va(n)n ||1||
lines.translation: and your thirst shall be quenched. Your love for Him shall increase four-fold. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਵਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਜਲ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਫਿਰਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: baabeehaa jal mahi teraa vaas hai jal hee maahi phiraahi ||
lines.translation: O rainbird, your place is in the water; you move around in the water.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੀ ਤਾਂ ਤੂੰ ਕੂਕਣ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jal kee saar na jaanahee taa(n) too(n) kookan paahi ||
lines.translation: But you do not appreciate the water, and so you cry out.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਥਲ ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸਿ ਵਰਸਦਾ ਖਾਲੀ ਕੋ ਥਾਉ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jal thal chahu dis varasadaa khaalee ko thaau naahi ||
lines.translation: In the water and on the land, it rains down in the ten directions. No place is left dry.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਤੈ ਜਲਿ ਵਰਸਦੈ ਤਿਖ ਮਰਹਿ ਭਾਗ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੇ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: etai jal varasadai tikh marahi bhaag tinaa ke naahi ||
lines.translation: With so much rain, those who are die of thirst are very unfortunate.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਿਨ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਈ ਜਿਨ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh tin sojhee paee jin vasiaa man maahi ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs understand; the Lord abides within their minds. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਥ ਜਤੀ ਸਿਧ ਪੀਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: naath jatee sidh peer kinai a(n)t na paaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Yogic Masters, celibates, Siddhas and spiritual teachers - none of them has found the limits of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੁਝੈ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh naam dhiaai tujhai samaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs meditate on the Naam, and merge in You, O Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੁਗ ਛਤੀਹ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jug chhateeh gubaar tis hee bhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: For thirty-six ages, God remained in utter darkness, as He pleased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲਾ ਬਿੰਬੁ ਅਸਰਾਲੁ ਤਿਨੈ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jalaa bi(n)b asaraal tinai varataaiaa ||
lines.translation: The vast expanse of water swirled around.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੀਲੁ ਅਨੀਲੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਸਰਜੀਤੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: neel aneel aga(n)m sarajeet sabaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Creator of all is Infinite, Endless and Inaccessible.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਨਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਵਾਦੁ ਭੁਖ ਤਿਹਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: agan upaaee vaad bhukh tihaaiaa ||
lines.translation: He formed fire and conflict, hunger and thirst.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: duneeaa kai sir kaal doojaa bhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Death hangs over the heads of the people of the world, in the love of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਖੈ ਰਖਣਹਾਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: rakhai rakhanahaar jin sabad bujhaaiaa ||9||
lines.translation: The Savior Lord saves those who realize the Word of the Shabad. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜਲੁ ਸਭ ਤੈ ਵਰਸਦਾ ਵਰਸੈ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu jal sabh tai varasadaa varasai bhaai subhaai ||
lines.translation: This rain pours down on all; it rains down in accordance with God's Loving Will.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਬਿਰਖਾ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੇ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: se birakhaa hareeaavale jo guramukh rahe samaai ||
lines.translation: Those trees become green and lush, which remain immersed in the Guru's Word.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਏਨਾ ਜੰਤਾ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak nadaree sukh hoi enaa ja(n)taa kaa dukh jaai ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, by His Grace, there is peace; the pain of these creatures is gone. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਿੰਨੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਚਮਕਿਆ ਵੁਠਾ ਛਹਬਰ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhi(n)nee rain chamakiaa vuthaa chhahabar laai ||
lines.translation: The night is wet with dew; lightning flashes, and the rain pours down in torrents.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਵੁਠੈ ਅਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਜਾਂ ਸਹੁ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit vuthai an dhan bahut oopajai jaa(n) sahu kare rajaai ||
lines.translation: Food and wealth are produced in abundance when it rains, if it is the Will of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਖਾਧੈ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੀਐ ਜੀਆਂ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit khaadhai man tripateeai jeeaa(n) jugat samaai ||
lines.translation: Consuming it, the minds of His creatures are satisfied, and they adopt the lifestyle of the way.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਹੈ ਕਦੇ ਆਵੈ ਕਦੇ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu dhan karate kaa khel hai kade aavai kade jaai ||
lines.translation: This wealth is the play of the Creator Lord. Sometimes it comes, and sometimes it goes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੀਆ ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: giaaneeaa kaa dhan naam hai sad hee rahai samaai ||
lines.translation: The Naam is the wealth of the spiritually wise. It is permeating and pervading forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾਂ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jin kau nadar kare taa(n) ihu dhan palai paai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who are blessed with His Glance of Grace receive this wealth. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਹਉ ਕੈ ਸਿਉ ਕਰੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap karaae kare aap hau kai siu karee pukaar ||
lines.translation: He Himself does, and causes all to be done. Unto whom can I complain?

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗਸੀ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape lekhaa ma(n)gasee aap karaae kaar ||
lines.translation: He Himself calls the mortal beings to account; He Himself causes them to act.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਗਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo tis bhaavai so theeai hukam kare gaavaar ||
lines.translation: Whatever pleases Him happens. Only a fool issues commands.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਛਡਾਏ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap chhadaae chhuteeai aape bakhasanahaar ||
lines.translation: He Himself saves and redeems; He Himself is the Forgiver.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੇ ਆਪਿ ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape vekhai sune aap sabhasai de aadhaar ||
lines.translation: He Himself sees, and He Himself hears; He gives His Support to all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh mahi ek varatadaa sir sir kare beechaar ||
lines.translation: He alone is pervading and permeating all; He considers each and every one.
